description: What's on in Florida in the next two weeks: festivals, concerts, farmers markets, boat-show and holiday events, library and park events, from about 30 cities' and counties' own public calendars (Tampa Bay, Orlando area, both coasts, the Keys, the Panhandle). Closest first within a radius when you give a position, soonest first. Each event links to its official page.

from.description: Or a start date YYYY-MM-DD (within the next 14 days)

lat.description: Latitude of where the person is or will be

miles.description: Radius around lat/lon in miles (default 25, max 150)

query.description: Words to match in the title or place, e.g. market, concert, fireworks

name: whats_on
title: What's on in Florida
